scope: Effective Table 57 entry/condition matrix and assertion-owner crosswalk. This is not a re-audit of each child clause; existing fresh child shards are referenced and their exact limits retained.

source.primary: doc/ISO_32000-2_sponsored_EC3.pdf, Table 57 begins physical p.180 / printed p.165, continues physical pp.181–183 / printed pp.166–168; page footers checked. EC3 #360 at physical182/printed167 deletes the Table 57 UseBlackPtComp default sentence. HTO appears in the effective continuation at physical183/printed168.
general_rules: Any subset of entries may be supplied to gs; results are cumulative and previously established values persist until explicitly overridden.
Table 56 overlaps some entries with operators; §8.4.1 NOTE 1 allows either route.
Initial graphics-state values come from Table 51, not from omission in a Table 57 dictionary. A missing entry preserves current state.
source_cautions: Most Table 57 entries are optional producer entries; malformed producer constraints do not automatically imply mandatory reader rejection.
The device's output condition matters: continuous-tone display rendering may omit PDF halftoning, but §10.5 transfer-function work carried inside /HT remains applicable.

ledger.assessment: The five references are a short index, not coverage of all effective table entries. Current code reads or intentionally ignores substantially more keys; the parent note enumerates those routes but is not itself assertion evidence. This matrix links those keys to child evidence and records gaps.

entries.effective_rule: Optional dictionary type marker; if present it shall be /ExtGState.
entries.consumer: No semantic branch in apply_ext_gstate; lookup dispatch treats the resource as a dictionary. Producer validity only.
entries.verdict: No required reader rejection inferred; no behavior gap claimed.

entries.effective_rule: Optional nonnegative line width; cumulative with w, later setter wins; §8.4.1 clips out-of-range numeric value without storing device adjustment.
entries.consumer: apply_ext_gstate sets Stroke.width; Stroke::device_width resolves zero/SA at paint time.
entries.verdict: Meaningful selected state and paint-time controls; no new gap.

entries.effective_rule: Optional integer line cap, Table 53 codes 0..2; cumulative and equivalent to J.
entries.consumer: apply_ext_gstate -> Stroke.cap -> path rendering.
entries.verdict: Selected state mapping covered; downstream cap behavior belongs to stroke shards.

entries.effective_rule: Optional integer line join, Table 54 codes 0..2; cumulative and equivalent to j.
entries.consumer: apply_ext_gstate -> Stroke.join.
entries.verdict: Selected state mapping covered; downstream join geometry belongs to stroke shards.

entries.effective_rule: Optional numeric miter limit, clipped to minimum 1; equivalent to M.
entries.consumer: apply_ext_gstate -> Stroke.miter_limit.
entries.verdict: Selected state mapping covered; downstream miter geometry belongs to stroke shards.

entries.effective_rule: Optional [dashArray dashPhase], with dashArray itself an array; equivalent to d and cumulative.
entries.consumer: apply_ext_gstate resolves outer array, nested array and members before applying dash.
entries.verdict: Nested dash-array/member indirection has a direct-control public pixel test; T77 two new assertions PASS wave58.

entries.effective_rule: Optional rendering-intent name; initial value is Table 51 RelativeColorimetric; unknown intent falls back to RelativeColorimetric.
entries.consumer: apply_ext_gstate sets state intent; colour conversion asks it at paint time.
entries.verdict: Distinct profile tables and state precedence are exercised; intent and BPC remain jointly scoped by child review.

entries.effective_rule: Optional boolean overprint for stroke; when op absent, OP also sets nonstroking; when op present, OP sets stroke only.
entries.consumer: apply_ext_gstate applies both entries jointly to stroking/filling state.
entries.verdict: Precedence and paint consumer controls exist; conditional CMYK support is covered in overprint shard.

entries.effective_rule: Optional boolean nonstroking overprint; if absent, inherits OP value in same dictionary.
entries.consumer: Joint OP/op state update in apply_ext_gstate.
entries.verdict: Selected independent stroke/fill behavior tested.

entries.effective_rule: Optional integer overprint mode; special zero-tint treatment only where supported process/spot output path applies.
entries.consumer: GraphicsState overprint_mode then per-paint overprint decision.
entries.verdict: OPM 0/1 and device-component control exist; sampled rows are not all Table 146 combinations.

entries.effective_rule: Optional [font size], corresponding to Tf. The font item specifically shall be an indirect reference; size is text-space number.
entries.consumer: content/font.rs::apply_ext_gstate_font loads by object identity and sets font and size.
entries.verdict: Valid indirect /Font consumer is exercised against Tf; independent Courier 600/1000 at 12 and Helvetica AFM 667/1000 at 24 predict distinct literal advances; parent reports test and Clippy PASS. The same test verifies a later gs replaces both font and size and an unrelated gs preserves them.

entries.effective_rule: Optional black-generation function mapping [0,1] to [0,1]; interacts with BG2.
entries.consumer: BlackGeneration::read stores stated pair; DeviceRGB-to-CMYK route may evaluate it.
entries.verdict: State-pair precedence and selected paint route have assertions; unsupported conversion branches remain explicitly qualified.

entries.effective_rule: Same function or /Default meaning the black-generation function at page start; takes precedence over BG if both occur.
entries.consumer: BlackGeneration::read resolves function/default and selects later BG2.
entries.verdict: Selected precedence/restore evidence; not every group/image consumer recertified here.

entries.effective_rule: Optional undercolour-removal function mapping [0,1] to [-1,1]; paired with UCR2.
entries.consumer: BlackGeneration route into RGB-to-CMYK conversion.
entries.verdict: Selected values have literal arithmetic controls.

entries.effective_rule: Same function or /Default meaning page-start UCR; takes precedence over UCR when both occur.
entries.consumer: BlackGeneration::read selects UCR2; state saved/restored with graphics state.
entries.verdict: Specific precedence assertion exists; device route conditions remain with colour-conversion shard.

entries.effective_rule: Optional transfer function, Identity or four functions; deprecated in PDF 2.0; RGB uses first three channels.
entries.consumer: TransferState applies after colour conversion and before optional device halftoning.
assertions: pdf-model/tests/halftone_transfer_public_spec_audit.rs::a_four_function_array_uses_the_first_three_for_rgb_not_the_gray_function (literal channel outputs); plus the three public tests named for /TR raster paths
entries.verdict: Public RGB first-three behavior and distinct-slot selection have four reviewed CPU-raster tests (4/4 PASS, fonts-transfer-wave23c.log); not all transfer carriers are covered.

entries.effective_rule: Same as TR, admits /Default for page-start function, and takes precedence over TR if both are present; deprecated in PDF 2.0.
entries.consumer: Transfer::read distinguishes unsaid vs Identity/Default; RGB transfer map consumed by marks.
entries.verdict: Model state precedence tested; public raster distinction is covered by the four parent-reviewed tests (4/4 PASS).

entries.effective_rule: Optional halftone dict/stream or /Default; screen may be omitted for continuous-tone device, but a contained TransferFunction overrides corresponding TR component under §10.5.
entries.consumer: halftone_transfer reads Type 5 component values or other dict TransferFunction; no screen generator used.
entries.verdict: Screen omission is conditional device scope; Type 5 and Type 6 transfer overrides have reviewed public raster assertions (4/4 PASS aggregate).

entries.effective_rule: Optional flatness tolerance equivalent to i; §10.7.2 expressly permits ignoring file-specified values.
entries.consumer: apply_ext_gstate reads and discards FL; raster chooses its own device-space tolerance.
entries.verdict: Valid deliberate ignore is source-authorized; equal-raster assertion is consistency only, while independent curve oracles live in raster tests.

entries.effective_rule: Optional smoothness tolerance; output device may impose internal limits; function sampling controls only shading smoothness.
entries.consumer: apply_ext_gstate sets state.smoothness; Ramp::resolution_for applies device floor.
assertions: raster/crates/raster-gpu/src/raster/tests/flatten.rs curve-area controls do not cover shading smoothness
entries.verdict: A public shading ramp compares requested smoothness with device sampling; limit is intentionally implementation/device bounded.

entries.effective_rule: Optional automatic stroke-adjustment flag; initial value is Table 51 false. Adjustment has separate thin-width and coordinate-grid effects.
entries.consumer: apply_ext_gstate sets Stroke.adjust; backend applies paint-time resolution/selected coordinate fitting.
assertions: pdf-model/tests/stroke_adjustment.rs and raster/ADR0085 current public width tests; ledger §10.7.5 remains partial for coordinate uniformity
entries.verdict: Width effect is controlled; do not equate Table57 read with full §10.7.5 coordinate-adjustment certification.

entries.effective_rule: Optional name or array; array deprecated in PDF 2.0. Reader uses first recognized array member, else Normal.
entries.consumer: stated_blend_mode sets blend, and resources_blend probes nested resources.
entries.verdict: Name/array recognition and indirect blend-name resolution are covered by direct and public pixel controls; T77 PASS wave58.

entries.effective_rule: Optional dict or /None; replaces prior soft mask rather than intersecting it; /None clears state.
entries.consumer: apply_ext_gstate builds or removes current soft mask.
entries.verdict: Replacement/clear and selected alpha/luminosity consumers are tested; not every nested profile route recertified here.

entries.effective_rule: Optional stroking alpha constant; initial value Table 51 1.0; shape/opacity meaning follows AIS.
entries.consumer: state.stroke_alpha; converted to stroke source shape/opacity in transparency pipeline.
assertions: pdf-model/tests/transparency_groups.rs and pdf-model/tests/overprint.rs selected stroke alpha consumer
entries.verdict: Selected stroke-specific alpha consumer has controls; not every operation family.

entries.effective_rule: Optional nonstroking alpha constant, same as CA; initial value 1.0; interacts with AIS and soft mask.
entries.consumer: state.fill_alpha for fills/images/text/shadings, with shape/opacity tracking.
entries.verdict: Selected alpha consumer and indirect alpha vs direct-control pixel test; T77 PASS wave58.

entries.effective_rule: Alpha-is-shape flag: true means SMask/constants are shape, false means opacity; applies also image dictionary SMask interpretation.
entries.consumer: state.alpha_is_shape plus group-scope readings; Transparency shape and image mask routes.
assertions: pdf-model/tests/transparency_groups.rs AIS shape-vs-opacity controls and explicit state-history tests
entries.verdict: Source distinction reaches public group/image consumers; no new gap found in this matrix pass.

entries.effective_rule: Optional text knockout flag for any font type; gs-installed TK inside BT..ET is ignored.
entries.consumer: state.text.knockout; text object is wrapped as group only where glyph overlap and compositing make it observable.
entries.verdict: Conditional behavior has valid overlapping controls and Type3 route.

entries.effective_rule: PDF 2.0 ON/OFF/Default; absent/Default semantics are processor-selected by §8.6.5.9. AbsoluteColorimetric forces compensation off. EC3 #360 deletes Table57 stated default, not the section rule.
entries.consumer: state.use_black_pt_comp combined with per-painted-object intent and ICC transform selection.
entries.verdict: Explicit ON/OFF/Default, intent precedence and omission preservation have assertions; default remains policy, not an ISO exact-value defect.

entries.effective_rule: Optional PDF 2.0 pair of origin coordinates; origin is in current coordinates but does not move with later coordinate-system changes; applies to halftone origin.
entries.consumer: No continuous-tone screen renderer/output path consumes an HTO origin; halftone-screen implementation is outside current device capability.
entries.verdict: No test needed for the unsupported screen condition; do not claim HTO rendering behavior. Relevant only if a halftone-capable device route is added.

residuals: Valid Font positive control executed PASS; see parent-review.json for expanded override/cumulative controls.

Four reviewed public CPU-raster tests for distinct RGB /TR channels and Type 5/Type 6 HT TransferFunction overrides pass (fonts-transfer-wave23c.log); this does not cover every transfer-carrier shape or screen generation.
HTO and screen rendering remain outside this continuous-tone output; no broad Table 57 field certification is made.
Table 57's optional/writer-side constraints are not converted into reader rejection obligations.
checkpoint85_followup: Parent checkpoint85: expanded valid Font consumer PASS; original draft execution labels are superseded by parent-review.json. Tests assert independent advances, replacement and cumulative gs state.
